2609.16779.title: Integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process with Large Language Models for Transparent Multi-Criteria Decision-Making
2609.16779.paper_summary: LLMs are increasingly employed in a wide range of decision-making tasks. However, the opacity of their internal reasoning makes it difficult to validate or interpret their outputs, and the need for interpretability becomes especially critical in high-stakes settings. This study examines the decision-making capabilities of LLMs through the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a classical and widely used multicriteria decision-making framework. We construct a new annotated benchmark based on AHP and propose the first end-to-end approach that enables LLMs to perform the complete AHP workflow. Experiments in real-world decision problems in the legal and higher-education ranking domains show that our method significantly improves alignment with expert judgments.
2609.16779.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 在各種決策任務中越來越受到廣泛應用。<lb/>然而，它們內部推理的透明度使得驗證或解釋其輸出變得困難，而在高風險環境中，對於可解釋性的需求變得尤為重要。<lb/>本研究通過層級分析法 (AHP) 考察 LLMs 的決策能力，這是一種經典且廣泛使用的多準則決策框架。<lb/>我們基於 AHP 構建了一個新的註釋基準，並提出了第一個端到端的方法，使 LLMs 能夠執行完整的 AHP 工作流程。<lb/>在法律和高等教育排名領域的實際決策問題中的實驗顯示，我們的方法顯著提高了與專家判斷的一致性。
